summary: Iteration 13 - WRITE flow validation. 11/11 new backend pytest cases PASS end-to-end (brand create + contact, BC create, interaction logging w/ timeline push, connect/status, alignment+SDF+approve+pay+advance, brief simulate-response with templated concept, snapshot inheriting concept from brief, contract sign, deliverable add updating milestones_total, final-report generate with KPI variance, reset-demo restoring 5 seeded BCs). Full UI walkthrough also PASS: New BC modal -> Connect (Log Interaction + Mark Qualified + Qualify to Frame) -> Plan (PlanStageActions sequentially surfaced bc-start-brainstorm then bc-send-brief) -> Add deliverable (window.prompt) -> Closure (Generate Final Report rendered KPI table + closure checklist) -> Reset demo confirmed and restored to exactly 5 BCs. /api/v3/admin/reset-demo invoked at end of run so DB is clean.

issues: React hydration console warnings: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>' originating from a data-ve-dynamic visual-editor wrapper instrumentation. Non-blocking but pollutes console and may cause hydration mismatch on slower clients. Suggest unwrapping or moving the marker outside <option>.

feature_test_results.Frontend BC detail Plan: PlanStageAction: PASS (bc-start-brainstorm + bc-send-brief observed; later CTAs unlock as prerequisites are met)

action_items: (Low) Resolve the React hydration warning caused by visual-editor span wrapper inside <select>/<option> on the New BC modal (only console-level, no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: create_brand returns 200 (FastAPI default); spec suggests 201 for resource creation - consistent across other v3 POSTs so not a blocker, but worth aligning later.
simulate_brief_response splits rate_card on en-dash; if a future creator's rate_card lacks that char the rate_low will equal full string. Defensive but works on current seed.
generate_final_report deletes existing report and re-inserts; this is idempotent-by-replace which is fine, but loses prior generated_at history. Acceptable for demo.
reset-demo wipes only collections present in get_v3_seed_data() keys - any new collection added later must also be added to the seed dict or it won't reset.
Add Deliverable uses window.prompt() which is fine for demo but blocks the page; consider replacing with a proper modal long-term.

PlanStageActions UI works as a wizard but doesn't appear gated by case.stage (Plan tab is reachable while stage=='connect'). For a true funnel demo, consider locking later tabs until the stage gate is crossed - functionally fine and lets RM peek ahead.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_BrandCo and TEST_UI E2E walkthrough BCs and a few related artifacts; final POST /api/v3/admin/reset-demo wiped them. DB is at clean 5-BC seeded state ready for human demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 write flows validated end-to-end. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_v3_iter13.py is self-contained (no auth) and ends with reset-demo so it can be re-run any time without leaving residue. Both test_v3_backend.py (read flows, 16 tests) and test_v3_iter13.py (write flows, 11 tests) together form the regression suite for /api/v3/*. UI testids confirmed: bc-reset-demo, bc-new, new-bc-modal, new-bc-submit, bc-li-{type,author,title,content,save}, bc-mark-qualified, bc-qualify-to-frame, bc-tab-{connect,frame,plan,deliver,closure}, bc-start-brainstorm, bc-send-brief, bc-simulate-response (renders after brief sent), bc-draft-snapshot, bc-draft-contract, bc-sign-contract, bc-add-deliverable, bc-generate-final-report.
rca of the issue: No defects found. One non-functional console warning (visual-editor instrumentation injecting a <span> wrapper inside <select>/<option>) noted as a minor design item.
